releases.name: Son of Beach
releases.summary: Start as a Beach Caretaker Intern. Clean up trash left behind by tourists and recycle it to unlock powerful new tools. Follow the changing tides to dig up hidden treasures beneath the sand. Catch seafood, run your own seafood stand, and sell rare coastal collectibles in your treasure shop.

releases.name: Take This Thing Out Of Me
releases.summary: It's a short game. But it can be a long one. It all depends on whether you were born under a lucky star... or whether you have the skill in your hands. Just... take the thing out!

releases.name: Spirestorm
releases.summary: Dive into enemies. Rebound toward the summit. Spirestorm is a fast arcade action roguelite where every hit fuels your climb. Battle towering guardians, forge evolving gear, and choose whether to bank your treasure or risk it for one more ascent.

releases.name: Prism Factory
releases.summary: "Yellow light, intensity 5." That is how orders arrive at a factory that works in light. Split white with a prism, take exactly what you need, and route it to the port that asked. Every split leaves you with less. Keep it up and the whole factory fills with light. How far can you get?

releases.name: Clocks Sleep at Zero
releases.summary: Are you a pop culture fanatic... and do you like fun and addictive puzzle games?!?! Play Puzzle Dash Pro: Celebrity Edition and have an absolute blast! Highlights:* Ad Free Version* Start with more hints and time boosts than the free version* Finish a puzzle in 60 seconds to advance to next level! * 5 Puzzle Worlds with 60 Levels in total * Collect stars to unlock categories, earn hints, and hit high scores * Need some help? Use time boosts to play a bit longer!

releases.name: Deadshift
releases.summary: Spend your last cash on a gun, a perk or a way out. DEADSHIFT is a single-player, top-down zombie survival roguelike. Repair barricades, unlock rooms and evolve your weapons across six maps. Beat the wave-30 boss, then keep fighting in endless mode.

releases.name: Clip Out: Backrooms
releases.summary: Play solo or in 2-player online co-op in this PSX style extraction roguelite based on the Backrooms. Explore procedural levels, scavenge for loot, and extract alive to upgrade your gear.

releases.name: Wildermeld
releases.summary: Hunt four dragons in a side-scrolling dark fantasy RPG. Explore a world generated anew each game, build your hero, brave dangerous dungeons, craft equipment and survive hunger, fatigue and the wilds. Earn four kingdoms' trust, with optional permadeath.

releases.name: Needle in a Haystack Simulator in a Haystack of Needle in a Haystack Simulators
releases.summary: 5,000,000 games on VAPOR, and all but one are clones. From your bedroom PC, screen procedurally generated store pages, stamp each fake on the detail that gives it away, put bots to work, and dig through the haystack for the one original. An incremental hidden object parody.

releases.name: Tea ceremony simulator
releases.summary: A quiet tearoom, but chaos in your hands! A first-person tea ceremony simulator where you brew matcha yourself—holding, tilting, and spilling. Nothing is automated, so mistakes get served as is. Score 80+ three times in a row to face a special guest. Can you score a perfect 100?

releases.name: ShotMachine
releases.summary: A western casino roguelite where every shot pays out. Load your revolver or shotgun round by round, fuse bullets into jackpot rounds, let your winnings ride at THE COUNT and steer your wagon across the frontier toward The House.

releases.name: Armored Raiders
releases.summary: Drive an armored war machine through endless enemy waves. A survivors-like shooter: auto-fire, dodge, unleash ultimates, pick upgrades and set the field ablaze. 3 crews, 4 stages, 5 difficulties, 765 achievements and permanent vehicle upgrades.

releases.name: Stay Lit
releases.summary: You're the last ember. He's the jerk who blew out the rest. Roll through 130 trap-packed levels in 26 worlds while Snuff, a shadow imp, rigs each level right in front of you and takes notes on how you play, so the level changes after you die.

releases.name: NGL Biathlon 2027
releases.summary: NGL Biathlon 2027 is a biathlon sports simulator. Control an athlete on the course and at the shooting range, compete in individual and relay events, develop a multi-season career, create custom tournaments, or simulate races in broadcast mode.

releases.name: Sort of Cheesy: Tidy up the Cheese Cave
releases.summary: A cozy first-person sorting game where you play as a rat with a nose for cheese. Sniff out, stack, and shelve over 300 types of cheese and milk. Complete sets to earn wedges, unlock cheesy powers like the Cheese’nado, and turn delicious chaos into satisfying order.

releases.name: Shelfish
releases.summary: Undo anything. Nothing locks. A cozy organizing puzzle where every drag snaps into place, a ghost shows exactly where each thing will land, and any mistake is one press from fixed. Tidy 40 levels across five rooms with Shelly the hermit crab, plus a fresh drawer every day.

releases.name: NecroSmash
releases.summary: A first-person survivors-like for solo or co-op play. Dash, slide, and smash through hundreds of enemies across multi-level arenas, level up mid-run, and face a boss at the end of every level. Clear a run to unlock new classes and new areas to test them in.

releases.name: Valliberum Memory Challenges
releases.summary: Three tabletop memory games on one virtual table. Remember species and colour, plan a nature expedition, or match pairs across a mischievous 8x8 map. Play solo for a high score, locally against a friend, or against the CPU.

releases.name: Backmare: Return of the nightmare
releases.summary: Immerse yourself in Backmare, a psychological survival horror experience designed to twist your reality and test your sanity. Here, survival is not merely about running away—it is about piecing together a fractured truth forgotten by time.

releases.name: Sengoku Fields of Empire
releases.summary: SENGOKU combines samurai action, economic management and grand strategy in feudal Japan. Lead the Tokugawa clan, build farms and trade networks, recruit warriors, forge alliances, conquer castles and rise through the Imperial Court to become Shogun.

releases.name: Cubetoria Pentomino Challenge
releases.summary: Twelve pieces. One perfect fit. Build all twelve pentominoes from real 3D cubes and fill the build plate, matching every lettered anchor. 220 computer-checked challenges on five plates, a Daily Challenge, Free Build and the Cubetoria crew to cheer you on.

releases.name: Slime Alchemy
releases.summary:
Slime Alchemy is a relaxing puzzle game where you must place pieces in specific locations on a hexagonal grid.

Are you ready to solve the puzzles and create slimes?

releases.name: Cucumber
releases.summary:
Cucumber is a jumping Cucumber Simulation Game, in which you will jump with your cucumber!

The Goal of the Game is to reach the highest possible jumping score with your cucumber.

Get a random cucumber every 3 hours and grow your fantastic cucumber collection!

releases.name: No Refunds
releases.summary: A 1–4 player co-op party game about running a live home-shopping show. Test mystery products backstage, then sell them on air with bold claims. Lie to boost sales, dodge the buzzer, and survive the returns, cats and chaos that follow.

releases.name: Coins in Place
releases.summary: Coins in Place is an incremental game where you work as a coin picker in a messy tavern. Pick up every coin before the day ends! Earn gems, buy upgrades, and recruit cats to help you. On Day 7, a mountain of coins awaits. Miss even one and you're stuck working another week.

releases.name: My Staff Are Dead! Paranormal Tycoon
releases.summary: Build a business empire with a workforce that's already dead. Recruit and train ghosts, run supernatural attractions, and balance profit, reputation and suspicion in this darkly humorous estate-management sim. The guests think it's all special effects. You know better.

releases.name: VICIOUS CIRCLE
releases.summary: Spiral into madness.

releases.name: Traymon World: Taskbar Monster RPG
releases.summary: The smallest monster idle RPG, right on your taskbar. Collect and manage monsters, each with unique skills and personality. Exploration runs on its own, so don't stop until you've assembled the ultimate party!

releases.name: Hop 'n' Karty
releases.summary: Hop and Marty are back in an all new Kart Racing game from Evilkookey games. Play as all your favourite characters from the Hop 'n' Marty and battle it out as you blast through the courses on your way to first place. Play alone or with friends and try to beat your best times.

releases.name: Monsters Can Cook
releases.summary: You were a bad person in your past life, and now you'll have to work as a junior chef even after death. Buy questionable ingredients, cook for guests, and improve your skills until your restaurant gets five stars.

releases.name: Jingi Tensei
releases.summary: A Tokyo prosecutor gets hit by a truck and is reborn in the city of the dead as the yakuza heir nobody wanted. An HD-2D turn-based JRPG: build your family, ink your back, take the turf… and sing karaoke against yōkai.

releases.name: HYPER BUTTERFLY
releases.summary: Fly, butterfly, fly!!! 15 original tracks. Custom mp3/ogg file support. Absolute madness and a breath of fresh air in the rhythm game genre! Have a nice day!!!

releases.name: Beryl
releases.summary: Team up with up to three friends in a free-to-play action RPG. Build your hero from 720 skills, find rare gear, socket gems into your gear, and fight through 840 kinds of monsters and 14 colossal bosses on ever-harder world difficulties.

releases.name: Alone at  School:Christmas
releases.summary: Alone at School: Christmas is an atmospheric horror walking simulator. Arriving at school before everyone else on Christmas morning, you soon realize that someone, or something, is already waiting for you in the empty halls.

releases.name: Meme Paint
releases.summary: Meme Paint is a unique take on the well-known Paint

releases.name: Incremental Pain Profit
releases.summary: Click, topple and profit! Knock over tiny wandering Humans, hire Animals to cause chaos, collect mountains of coins and grow your ridiculous empire. Unlock powerful Rebirth upgrades, defeat Bosses and turn a peaceful board into a glorious mess of falling people.

releases.name: Coma Dreams
releases.summary: Guide a wounded Marine through a nightmare born of his own coma, facing the horrors of war, scarce ammunition, puzzles, and dark labyrinths. Evade a colossal, relentless pursuer, overcome manifestations of his deepest psychological traumas at every stage, and help him wake up and return to reality.

releases.name: Warrior Quest
releases.summary: Warrior Quest is a single-player, text-driven dark-fantasy RPG where old-school dungeon crawling meets next-gen, free-form, offline AI diplomacy. Fight, sneak, negotiate in your own words, recruit unlikely companions... and whatever you do, roll well.

releases.name: Decrypting Life
releases.summary: Decrypting Life is a short, nostalgic incremental game where you restore corrupted files to uncover a story from the 2000s

releases.name: GBald
releases.summary: The maid asks if you have an appointment. It's your house. Take it back in GBald, a third-person arcade shooter. Dodge flying pots, fight through 30 waves of furious staff and roosters, and hit the gym between waves.

releases.name: PTW
releases.summary: A fighting game with no fighting. When two players meet, the higher level wins. Levels are sold one at a time, one press each. Right now, someone on the board is one level above you.

releases.name: Ordanum
releases.summary: Ordanum is a combo centred PvP auto battler where the order of your Sigils is the driving system. Arrange and rearrange your Sigils then watch your creation play out against other players' builds.

releases.name: One Shade Closer
releases.summary: Mix paint from 12 basic colors to touch up chipped paint on pillars, doors, lockers and playground equipment. A quiet little game for bedtime or a few spare minutes: just one small repair at a time. No timers, no scores. You decide when it's done.

releases.name: All Peaceful at the Adventurer's Guild Today.
releases.summary: All Peaceful at the Adventurer's Guild Today is the ultimate tiny idle RPG, designed to fit neatly at the bottom of your desktop. Just leave it running on the side of your screen, and watch your very own guild grow. Become the Guild Master and build a guild that's truly yours!

releases.name: Memory King (Dogsoul Games)
releases.summary: Look closely, then answer from memory! Challenge friends in 2–8 player tournaments full of cute animal scenes. Import your own pictures, write multiple-choice questions, and share custom packs for a challenge only your group could create.

releases.name: Touhou Sukusuku Racing
releases.summary: Touhou Sukusuku Racing is a cute, casual racer set in Gensokyo and beyond. Speed through Touhou-inspired tracks, outplay rivals with varied items, and chase the championship. Between races, play with your Sukusuku friends at home and take photos together!

releases.name: STASIS LAST RAIL
releases.summary: A Western-flavored, procedurally generated top-down shooter in retro pixel art. Blast through 50 floors across 5 chapters, smash enemy spawn holes, freeze incoming bullets with your Stasis skill, and take down a boss every five floors, including a two-form final boss.

releases.name: Duel Era
releases.summary: This game is a collectible card battle game centered around monster summoning, magical traps and chain strategies. Collect cards, build decks, predict opponents, and create your own winning chains in the battles.

releases.name: Mischka Cars
releases.summary: Top-down combat racing with rockets, mines and oil, a career across five leagues, rollercoaster stunts on stilted tracks and car football with ramps and bumpers. Tune your car in the garage, build your own tracks and earn 75 achievements.
